format: Pizza Ranch family restaurant with FunZone arcade, retrofit/leased premises (5,400 sq. ft. restaurant / 2,400 sq. ft. FunZone)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Pizza Ranch® franchise is from $2,305,500 to $2,987,000 if you lease or remodel your Restaurant and $3,330,500 to $5,134,500 if you build a new Restaurant. This includes $49,100 that must be paid to us or our affiliate.

fee.quote: You must pay a franchise fee of $30,000 for each Franchise Agreement you sign with us. You must pay us $7,500 at the time you sign a Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: $7,500 at signing (refundable only if location not approved within 6 months), $22,500 at start of construction. Also required: Management Training Fee $15,500 plus $200 per trainee for materials, and $3,600 marketing start-up materials from affiliate PR Production Fund, Inc. ADA development fee typically $7,500 per market, applied to franchise fees.

royalty.flat: Greater of $500 or 3.5% of Gross Revenues per month
royalty.quote: Royalty Greater of $500 or 3.5% of Gross Revenues per month Payable monthly on 10th day of the next month

adFund.quote: Marketing and Production Fund Contribution Up to 5% of Gross Revenues (current contribution is 2.25%)
adFund.note: Fund currently 2.25%, up to 5%. Local and regional advertising: up to the difference between 5% and the fund contribution; currently only the difference between 3% and other contributions (total advertising currently 3% of Gross Revenue).

otherRecurring.name: Promotions
otherRecurring.amount: ranges from $50 to $500 per month (subject to change by us)

transferFee.amount: Transfer and Training Fee $10,000 Payable prior to transfer

special: Royalty has a $500 monthly minimum, and a separate 0.5% Service Fee is charged on top of the 3.5% royalty. New restaurants must open with a FunZone arcade (arcade games $450,000 to $550,000). Rent not estimated in Item 7 (lease cost excluded); new ground-up option $3,330,500 to $5,134,500 includes land $0 to $800,000.
issues: Headline uses the FunZone-restaurant table (94 units, Table 3) because no single all-restaurant average is printed. Toward-franchisor $49,100 taken from cover (not itemized in Item 7).
